★Request
Display Victoire Pisa (Winter Jersey)
Display Rose Kingdom (Winter Jersey)
Display Eishin Flash (Winter Jersey)

Flash bows politely on line 2
Something you'd like to ask... me?
Hehe...♪

Hmph, to truly enjoy the finest of races, thorough tactical analysis is essential.
The board is in motion even when we are not running on the track.

While part of it might just be her soft, gentle presence,
she seemed to hold something inside that went beyond a simple, defined goal.

Oh, my!
Are you inviting me to train together?

Yes. To reach the heights I aspire to, worthy rivals to stand alongside me are essential.
This match—I ask that you accept it.

Hehe. Your strategies always manage to surprise me, Ruler-san.
I'm truly looking forward to seeing how it unfolds.
Hehe... I'll do my absolute best not to disappoint you♪

Yes, of course.
Besides, I'm genuinely excited for the chance to run with you, Rose-san.
The conditions are—Turf 2,400m, simulating the Japanese Derby.

And there is one more formidable contender.
...Her.

When I dropped by the training grounds, I happened upon Victoire Pisa
talking with some other Umamusume.
Yes, however—
Wh-What... !?
—or so she says.

Hey, isn't that smoke coming from down the alley...?
Wait... is that a fire?!
But this isn't over yet...!

...What I want to do... you say?
Well... let me see. It's just—

Eishin Flash. She is also a leading contender for the upcoming Classic campaign.
Renowned for her composure in never missing an opening, perfectly matched with her razor-sharp late burst.

Standing beside Victoire Pisa is... Rose Kingdom.
Hailing from the prestigious "Bara Clan," she is one of the most prominent talents of their generation.

Oh, my! Hello there, Ruler-san.
It's been three days since we last met on the grounds, hasn't it?

You have my thanks. As expected, there is much to gain from competing against a worthy rival.
This training session only had meaning because you accepted, Pisa.

I heard today's training would gather top runners ideal for testing tactics.
If that's the case, why wouldn't I test if this decisive move can truly seize control of the board?

I appreciate it. Furthermore... other formidable competitors are set to take part as well.
For instance—

And yet, could someone hailed as one of the most promising talents of her generation
truly blossom this far without a clear sense of purpose?

With so many leading contenders for the upcoming Classic campaign gathering, I have no reason to decline.
To merely watch such a prime matchup from the sidelines—would be rather tasteless, wouldn't it?

Hehe, I'm glad I could be of help.
To be able to run alongside everyone... there's nothing that makes me happier.

She is Rulership. A cerebral Umamusume from the same training
academy as Air Groove, who is known by the moniker "The Empress."

Down to the minute as always, I see. Still... heh, not bad.
Executing everything according to one's own calculations... that is vital for victory.

Yet that doesn't mean she is passive compared to the other Umamusume,
nor that she is falling behind in the slightest.

Surrounded by such distinct personalities,
a thought suddenly crossed my mind regarding Victoire Pisa—

"To become a king my family can be proud of," "To dominate the board in races."
Like her rivals, most runners have clear, definitive goals, but—

Drei... zwei... eins—Here I come...!
Hyaaaaaaah...!

Could that be Flash-san?
Heh, talk about an ideal matchup.

Impressive...!
I was certain I launched my move at the absolute perfect moment...!

—Pisa-san. I have been watching your running for some time now.
I shall face you with everything I have today.

Not enough cards in hand... especially against Pisa, huh?
*sigh*... I fold, I fold. Guess I'll just head back to my room and sleep it off...

I will be carrying out my scheduled routine from now.
As I informed Rose-san, we will begin at precisely 16:12.

—She undeniably feels a deep sense of joy and excitement
when it comes to running. There is no doubt about that.

That was an excellent match.
I have identified areas I need to reflect upon as well, so I hope we can run together again when the opportunity arises.

A few days after the joint training.
On my way back from shopping, I happened to run into Victoire Pisa.
